review.summary: The traversal core is verified: the new east-side alley connector (WorldCollision/AlleyPavement, X 6–22, Z 8–20) extends beyond the old X −1..6 boundary, with a foot excursion to 6.53 m beyond (15 outside samples ≈1.6 s, return by 15.97 s) and a vehicle excursion to 13.77 m beyond (48 outside samples ≈5.0 s, return by 33.63 s), all within 150 s and with no R reset during either leg. All 188 support probes land on rendered pavement (0 uncovered) and the walk/world/vehicle-reset/courier/combat regressions pass. Frames corroborate: frame-001.png (t=10.8) shows walking outside among the yellow bollards and dumpster in the new alley, frame-002.png (t=12.9) shows the bare red-box interior, frame-006.png (t=26.8) shows driving outside in the blue coupe nose-pressed toward the corner, and frame-010.png (t=35.0) shows the car back at the junction/street edge with a MISSION FAILED panel after the legs completed. However, the run's own prop-transform check fails within this scope: 16 samples report world-size/orientation mismatches on the newly placed extension props (AlleyBollardS world-size + world-orientation, AlleyBollardN world-size, AlleyDumpster body/wheels) — the reused clones do not match the originals' scale/orientation, violating the "coherent existing props" requirement and risking collider-vs-visual mismatch in the new junction. Polish was requested yet frame-002/frame-006 show a flat red-box interior far from the Chicago alley target. Partial pass requiring fixes.
